class.name: TrainWipers
class.brief_description: Configures the windshield wiper programmer switch.
class.description: [TrainWipers] wraps the FIZ [code]WiperList:[/code] section. [b]Not wired to the mover:[/b] this fork of the MaSzyna simulation has no field anywhere for wiper state or configuration - "wiper" does not appear in [code]MOVER.h[/code], [code]Mover.cpp[/code], or any GDScript addon. There is nothing in [code]TMoverParameters[/code] to write these values into, so this node only stores the configuration; it currently has no effect on the simulated vehicle. It exists so the section has a documented home, ready to be wired up if wiper simulation is ever implemented.
